question.text: Which of the following must be disclosed in a Cat III AIF's Investor Charter?

answer.text: Vision/Mission, services, grievance redressal, timelines, investor responsibilities

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.18, the Investor Charter contains vision/mission, business transactions, services, timelines, grievance-redressal details, and investor responsibilities. The Trap: Philosophy, holdings, and track record are in other documents (PPM, quarterly reports). Cross-Exam Context: Common across SEBI Investor Charters (Broker, RTA, DP, Mutual Fund). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Disclose Investor Charter to existing investors via registered email one-time; include in PPM for new schemes.
